func TestWindowsFixtureChild(t *testing.T) {
	if len(os.Args) < 2 {
		return
	}
	switch os.Args[len(os.Args)-1] {
	case "fixture-child-success":
		os.Stdout.WriteString("owned child\n")
		os.Exit(0)
	case "fixture-child-sleep":
		time.Sleep(time.Minute)
		os.Exit(0)
	case "fixture-child-descendant":
		executable, err := os.Executable()
		if err != nil {
			os.Exit(2)
		}
		child := exec.Command(executable, "-test.run=^TestWindowsFixtureChild$", "--", "fixture-child-sleep")
		if err := child.Start(); err != nil {
			os.Exit(3)
		}
		os.Exit(0)
	case "fixture-child-control":
		if len(os.Args) < 4 || os.Args[len(os.Args)-3] != "--" {
			os.Exit(4)
		}
		conn, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp4", os.Args[len(os.Args)-2], 5*time.Second)
		if err != nil {
			os.Exit(5)
		}
		if _, err := io.Copy(io.Discard, conn); err != nil {
			os.Exit(6)
		}
		if err := conn.Close(); err != nil {
			os.Exit(7)
		}
		os.Exit(0)
	case "fixture-child-wait-input":
		if _, err := io.ReadFull(os.Stdin, make([]byte, 1)); err != nil {
			os.Exit(8)
		}
		os.Exit(0)
	case "fixture-child-environment":
		if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(windowsTestEnvironmentValues()); err != nil {
			os.Exit(9)
		}
		os.Exit(0)
	}
}

func TestWindowsEnvironmentKeyAndFold(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		entry, key string
	}{
		{"Path=one=two", "Path"},
		{"EMPTY=", "EMPTY"},
		{`=C:=C:\work`, "=C:"},
		{"=D:=", "=D:"},
		{"名称=值", "名称"},
	} {
		key, err := windowsEnvironmentKey(test.entry)
		if err != nil || key != test.key {
			t.Fatal("valid environment entry did not retain its key")
		}
	}
	if windowsEnvironmentFold("pAtH-äÉİı-名称") != "PATH-äÉİı-名称" {
		t.Fatal("environment folding changed non-ASCII characters or missed ASCII letters")
	}
}

func TestWindowsEnvironmentBlock(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name        string
		environment []string
		want        string
	}{
		{name: "nil-explicit", want: "\x00\x00"},
		{name: "empty-explicit", environment: []string{}, want: "\x00\x00"},
		{
			name: "stable-first-separator-order",
			environment: []string{
				"z=last-ascii", `=D:=D:\later`, "b=one=two", "A=first", `=C:=C:\earlier`, "a=second", "Ä=unicode",
			},
			want: "=D:=D:\\later\x00=C:=C:\\earlier\x00A=first\x00a=second\x00b=one=two\x00z=last-ascii\x00Ä=unicode\x00\x00",
		},
		{name: "empty-value", environment: []string{"EMPTY="}, want: "EMPTY=\x00\x00"},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			before := slices.Clone(test.environment)
			block, err := windowsEnvironmentBlock(test.environment)
			if err != nil || block == nil || !slices.Equal(block, utf16.Encode([]rune(test.want))) {
				t.Fatal("explicit environment block has incorrect ordering or termination")
			}
			if !slices.Equal(test.environment, before) {
				t.Fatal("environment block construction mutated caller entries")
			}
		})
	}
	block, err := windowsEnvironmentBlock([]string{"K=文🧪", "E="})
	want := []uint16{'E', '=', 0, 'K', '=', 0x6587, 0xd83e, 0xddea, 0, 0}
	if err != nil || !slices.Equal(block, want) {
		t.Fatal("Unicode environment block lost UTF-16 units or entry separators")
	}
}

func TestWindowsEnvironmentInvalidEntries(t *testing.T) {
	const secret = "sensitive-environment-value"
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name, entry string
	}{
		{"empty", ""},
		{"missing-separator", secret},
		{"missing-key", "=" + secret},
		{"empty-special-key", "==" + secret},
		{"nul-key", "NA\x00ME=" + secret},
		{"nul-value", "NAME=" + secret + "\x00"},
		{"invalid-key-utf8", "\xff=" + secret},
		{"invalid-value-utf8", "NAME=" + secret + "\xff"},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			key, keyErr := windowsEnvironmentKey(test.entry)
			environment := []string{"Z=valid", test.entry, "A=valid"}
			before := slices.Clone(environment)
			block, blockErr := windowsEnvironmentBlock(environment)
			if key != "" || block != nil || !errors.Is(keyErr, syscall.EINVAL) || !errors.Is(blockErr, syscall.EINVAL) {
				t.Fatal("invalid environment entry did not fail with EINVAL")
			}
			if strings.Contains(keyErr.Error(), secret) || strings.Contains(blockErr.Error(), secret) {
				t.Fatal("environment validation exposed an entry value")
			}
			if !slices.Equal(environment, before) {
				t.Fatal("failed environment construction mutated caller entries")
			}
		})
	}
}

const windowsEnvironmentTestKey = "RFS_FIXTURE_OWNER_ENV_TEST"

type windowsTestEnvironmentValue struct {
	Value   string `json:"value"`
	Present bool   `json:"present"`
}

func windowsTestEnvironmentValues() map[string]windowsTestEnvironmentValue {
	values := make(map[string]windowsTestEnvironmentValue, 2)
	for _, key := range []string{"SystemRoot", windowsEnvironmentTestKey} {
		value, present := os.LookupEnv(key)
		values[key] = windowsTestEnvironmentValue{Value: value, Present: present}
	}
	return values
}

type windowsEnvironmentTestPlatform struct {
	windowsPlatform
	environment []string
}

func (p windowsEnvironmentTestPlatform) Start(executable string, args []string, directory string) (child, error) {
	return p.windowsPlatform.StartWithEnvironment(executable, args, directory, p.environment)
}

func TestWindowsOwnedChildEnvironment(t *testing.T) {
	executable, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	parent := os.Environ()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if !slices.Equal(os.Environ(), parent) {
			t.Error("owned child launch changed the parent environment")
		}
	})
	inherited := windowsTestEnvironmentValues()
	childValue := "explicit-child-value-文🧪"
	if inherited[windowsEnvironmentTestKey].Value == childValue {
		childValue += "-changed"
	}
	explicit := make([]string, 0, len(parent)+1)
	for _, entry := range parent {
		key, _, _ := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
		if !strings.EqualFold(key, windowsEnvironmentTestKey) {
			explicit = append(explicit, entry)
		}
	}
	explicit = append(explicit, windowsEnvironmentTestKey+"="+childValue)
	explicitBefore := slices.Clone(explicit)
	wantExplicit := maps.Clone(inherited)
	wantExplicit[windowsEnvironmentTestKey] = windowsTestEnvironmentValue{Value: childValue, Present: true}
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name string
		host platform
		want map[string]windowsTestEnvironmentValue
	}{
		{"inherited", windowsPlatform{}, inherited},
		{"explicit-child-only", windowsEnvironmentTestPlatform{environment: explicit}, wantExplicit},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			output, err := runTool(ctx, test.host, executable, []string{"-test.run=^TestWindowsFixtureChild$", "--", "fixture-child-environment"}, privateTestDirectory(t), "environment")
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal("owned environment child did not complete successfully")
			}
			var observed map[string]windowsTestEnvironmentValue
			if err := json.Unmarshal(output, &observed); err != nil {
				t.Fatal("owned environment child returned invalid JSON")
			}
			if !maps.Equal(observed, test.want) {
				t.Fatal("owned child did not receive the selected environment values")
			}
			if !slices.Equal(os.Environ(), parent) || !slices.Equal(explicit, explicitBefore) {
				t.Fatal("owned child launch mutated its parent environment or caller entries")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestWindowsExplicitEnvironmentRejectedBeforeLaunch(t *testing.T) {
	const executable = `C:\fixture\unlaunched.exe`
	const secret = "sensitive-environment-value"
	process, err := (windowsPlatform{}).StartWithEnvironment(executable, nil, `C:\fixture`, []string{"NAME=" + secret + "\x00"})
	if process != nil {
		process.Finish()
		t.Fatal("invalid explicit environment created a child")
	}
	var launch *windowsLaunchError
	if !errors.Is(err, syscall.EINVAL) || !errors.As(err, &launch) {
		t.Fatal("invalid explicit environment lost its launch error or EINVAL cause")
	}
	facts := launch.Facts
	if !facts.CleanupConfirmed || facts.RequestedImage != executable || facts.PID != nil ||
		facts.CreateProcess != nil || facts.AssignJob != nil || facts.QueryImage != nil || facts.QueryMachine != nil ||
		facts.ResumeThread != nil || facts.PreviousSuspendCount != nil || facts.ActualImage != "" ||
		facts.ProcessMachine != nil || facts.NativeMachine != nil || facts.CommandLineUnits != 0 || facts.CommandLineSHA256 != "" {
		t.Fatal("invalid explicit environment fabricated launch stages or unconfirmed cleanup")
	}
	if strings.Contains(err.Error(), secret) {
		t.Fatal("failed launch exposed an invalid environment value")
	}
}

func TestWindowsOwnedJobNormalAndCancellation(t *testing.T) {
	executable, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, mode := range []string{"fixture-child-success", "fixture-child-sleep", "fixture-child-descendant"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			budget := 5 * time.Second
			if mode == "fixture-child-sleep" {
				budget = 200 * time.Millisecond
			}
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), budget)
			defer cancel()
			output, err := runTool(ctx, windowsPlatform{}, executable, []string{"-test.run=^TestWindowsFixtureChild$", "--", mode}, privateTestDirectory(t), "child")
			if mode == "fixture-child-success" {
				if err != nil || !strings.Contains(string(output), "owned child") {
					t.Fatalf("normal owned job: %q %v", output, err)
				}
			} else if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("live owned job was reported graceful")
			}
			if mode == "fixture-child-descendant" && !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "forced termination") {
				t.Fatalf("descendant job ownership was not observed: %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestWindowsOwnedChildTerminationClosesPipes(t *testing.T) {
	executable, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	process, err := (windowsPlatform{}).Start(executable, []string{"-test.run=^TestWindowsFixtureChild$", "--", "fixture-child-sleep"}, privateTestDirectory(t))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	owned := process.(*windowsChild)
	facts := owned.LaunchFacts()
	if facts.PID == nil || *facts.PID != process.PID() || facts.PreviousSuspendCount == nil || *facts.PreviousSuspendCount != 1 ||
		facts.RequestedImage != executable || !strings.EqualFold(facts.ActualImage, executable) || facts.ProcessMachine == nil ||
		facts.NativeMachine == nil || *facts.ProcessMachine != 0 || *facts.NativeMachine != 0xaa64 || len(facts.CommandLineSHA256) != 64 {
		t.Fatalf("native launch facts are incomplete: %#v", facts)
	}
	for _, call := range []*windowsLaunchCall{facts.CreateProcess, facts.AssignJob, facts.QueryImage, facts.QueryMachine, facts.ResumeThread} {
		if call == nil || !call.Returned || call.Error != "" || call.OffsetNanos < 0 || call.DurationNanos < 0 {
			t.Fatalf("native launch stage is incomplete: %#v", call)
		}
	}
	defer process.Finish()
	active, err := jobActive(owned.job)
	if err != nil || active != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("returned child is not exclusively job-owned: active=%d error=%v", active, err)
	}
	forced, err := process.Finish()
	if err != nil || !forced {
		t.Fatalf("termination not confirmed: forced=%v error=%v", forced, err)
	}
	if _, err := io.Copy(io.Discard, process.Output()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("owned output pipe remained open")
	}
}

type ownedInputTestPipe struct {
	writes, closes atomic.Int32
	closeErr       error
}

func (p *ownedInputTestPipe) Write(data []byte) (int, error) { p.writes.Add(1); return len(data), nil }
func (p *ownedInputTestPipe) Close() error                   { p.closes.Add(1); return p.closeErr }

func TestOwnedProcessInputCloseOnce(t *testing.T) {
	for _, closeErr := range []error{nil, errors.New("close failed")} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprint(closeErr), func(t *testing.T) {
			pipe := &ownedInputTestPipe{closeErr: closeErr}
			input := &ownedProcessInput{pipe: pipe}
			if n, err := input.Write([]byte("one")); n != 3 || err != nil {
				t.Fatal(n, err)
			}
			var group sync.WaitGroup
			for range 8 {
				group.Go(func() {
					if err := input.Close(); !errors.Is(err, closeErr) {
						t.Errorf("close result: %v", err)
					}
				})
			}
			group.Wait()
			if err := input.Close(); !errors.Is(err, closeErr) || pipe.closes.Load() != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("duplicate/sticky close: %v %d", err, pipe.closes.Load())
			}
			if n, err := input.Write([]byte("two")); n != 0 || !errors.Is(err, os.ErrClosed) || pipe.writes.Load() != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("write after close: %d %v", n, err)
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("close interrupts blocked write", func(t *testing.T) {
		reader, writer := io.Pipe()
		defer reader.Close()
		defer writer.Close()
		input := &ownedProcessInput{pipe: writer}
		done := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { _, err := input.Write([]byte("blocked")); done <- err }()
		if _, err := io.ReadFull(reader, make([]byte, 1)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		closed := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { closed <- input.Close() }()
		select {
		case err := <-closed:
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		case <-time.After(time.Second):
			t.Fatal("input close waited for its blocked write")
		}
		select {
		case err := <-done:
			if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("blocked write became success")
			}
		case <-time.After(time.Second):
			t.Fatal("input close waited for its blocked write")
		}
	})
}

func TestWindowsResumePostcondition(t *testing.T) {
	for _, count := range []uint32{0, 1, 2, ^uint32(0)} {
		if err := checkWindowsResumeCount(count); (err == nil) != (count == 1) {
			t.Fatalf("resume count %d: %v", count, err)
		}
	}
}

func TestWindowsLaunchObservations(t *testing.T) {
	start := time.Unix(10, 0)
	now := start.Add(3 * time.Millisecond)
	clock := func() time.Time { return now }
	cause := errors.New("native query failed")
	var call *windowsLaunchCall
	err := observeWindowsLaunchCall(start, clock, &call, func() error {
		if call == nil || call.Returned {
			t.Fatal("unfinished call fabricated a returned result")
		}
		now = now.Add(2 * time.Millisecond)
		return cause
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, cause) || call.OffsetNanos != int64(3*time.Millisecond) || call.DurationNanos != int64(2*time.Millisecond) || !call.Returned || call.Error != cause.Error() {
		t.Fatalf("call facts: %#v %v", call, err)
	}
	for _, fail := range []string{"", "image", "machine"} {
		t.Run(fail, func(t *testing.T) {
			facts := windowsLaunchFacts{RequestedImage: "requested.exe"}
			machines := 0
			err := observeWindowsImage(&facts, start, clock, func() (string, error) {
				if fail == "image" {
					return "untrusted-partial.exe", cause
				}
				return "actual.exe", nil
			}, func() (uint16, uint16, error) {
				machines++
				if fail == "machine" {
					return 1, 2, cause
				}
				return 0, 0xaa64, nil
			})
			if fail == "" {
				if err != nil || facts.ActualImage != "actual.exe" || facts.ProcessMachine == nil || *facts.ProcessMachine != 0 || facts.NativeMachine == nil || *facts.NativeMachine != 0xaa64 {
					t.Fatalf("image facts: %#v %v", facts, err)
				}
			} else {
				wrapped := &windowsLaunchError{Facts: facts, Cause: errors.Join(cause, err)}
				if !errors.Is(wrapped, cause) || facts.ProcessMachine != nil || facts.NativeMachine != nil {
					t.Fatalf("failed query fabricated machine facts: %#v %v", facts, wrapped)
				}
				if fail == "image" && (facts.ActualImage != "" || machines != 0 || facts.QueryMachine != nil) {
					t.Fatalf("failed image query fabricated later facts: %#v", facts)
				}
				if fail == "machine" && facts.ActualImage != "actual.exe" {
					t.Fatal("validated image fact was lost")
				}
			}
		})
	}
	if err := observeWindowsLaunchCall(start, clock, &call, func() error { return errors.New(strings.Repeat("x", 600)) }); err == nil || !call.ErrorTruncated || len(call.Error) != 512 {
		t.Fatal("native error detail was not bounded")
	}
}

func TestJobAccountingABIAndReturnedLength(t *testing.T) {
	if err := checkJobAccountingABI(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var value jobAccounting
	if unsafe.Sizeof(value) != 48 || unsafe.Alignof(value) != 8 || unsafe.Offsetof(value.ActiveProcesses) != 40 || unsafe.Offsetof(value.TerminatedProcesses) != 44 {
		t.Fatal("Windows 64-bit accounting ABI differs")
	}
	for _, length := range []uint32{0, 40, 47, 48, 49, 96} {
		active, err := readJobActive(func(value *jobAccounting, returned *uint32) error {
			value.TotalProcesses = 99
			value.ActiveProcesses = 3
			*returned = length
			return nil
		})
		if length == 48 {
			if err != nil || active != 3 {
				t.Fatalf("active count confused with total: %d %v", active, err)
			}
		} else if err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("accepted returned length %d", length)
		}
	}
	failure := errors.New("query failure")
	if _, err := readJobActive(func(*jobAccounting, *uint32) error { return failure }); !errors.Is(err, failure) {
		t.Fatalf("lost query error: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestOwnedJobRundownTransitions(t *testing.T) {
	queryFailure := errors.New("query failure")
	terminateFailure := errors.New("terminate failure")
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name             string
		exited           bool
		initial          []uint32
		queryErr         error
		postQueryErr     error
		terminateErr     error
		remainAfterForce bool
		wantForced       bool
		wantError        error
		wantElapsed      time.Duration
	}{
		{name: "exited-counter-settles", exited: true, initial: []uint32{1, 1, 0}, wantElapsed: 2 * time.Second},
		{name: "exited-empty", exited: true, initial: []uint32{0}},
		{name: "live-root-forces-before-query", exited: false, initial: []uint32{1}, wantForced: true},
		{name: "descendant-exceeds-natural-budget", exited: true, initial: []uint32{1}, wantForced: true, wantError: errJobRundownDeadline, wantElapsed: 5 * time.Second},
		{name: "query-error-remains-failure", exited: true, initial: []uint32{1}, queryErr: queryFailure, wantForced: true, wantError: queryFailure},
		{name: "forced-confirmation-query-error", exited: false, initial: []uint32{1}, postQueryErr: queryFailure, wantForced: true, wantError: queryFailure},
		{name: "termination-error-remains-failure", exited: false, initial: []uint32{1}, terminateErr: terminateFailure, wantForced: true, wantError: terminateFailure},
		{name: "forced-confirmation-stays-nonempty", exited: true, initial: []uint32{1}, remainAfterForce: true, wantForced: true, wantError: errJobRundownDeadline, wantElapsed: 10 * time.Second},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			started := time.Unix(1000, 0)
			now := started
			reads := 0
			terminations := 0
			firstOperation := ""
			ops := jobRundownOps{
				now: func() time.Time { return now },
				active: func() (uint32, error) {
					if firstOperation == "" {
						firstOperation = "query"
					}
					if terminations != 0 {
						if test.postQueryErr != nil {
							return 0, test.postQueryErr
						}
						if test.remainAfterForce {
							return 1, nil
						}
						return 0, nil
					}
					if test.queryErr != nil {
						return 0, test.queryErr
					}
					index := min(reads, len(test.initial)-1)
					reads++
					return test.initial[index], nil
				},
				terminate: func() error {
					if firstOperation == "" {
						firstOperation = "terminate"
					}
					terminations++
					return test.terminateErr
				},
				pause: func(deadline time.Time) error {
					now = now.Add(time.Second)
					if now.After(deadline) {
						t.Fatal("wait passed its deadline")
					}
					return nil
				},
			}
			forced, err := finishJobRundown(test.exited, started.Add(10*time.Second), ops)
			if forced != test.wantForced || (test.wantError == nil && err != nil) || (test.wantError != nil && !errors.Is(err, test.wantError)) {
				t.Fatalf("forced=%v err=%v", forced, err)
			}
			if forced && terminations != 1 || !forced && terminations != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("termination count %d", terminations)
			}
			if !test.exited && firstOperation != "terminate" {
				t.Fatal("live root was given natural-exit grace")
			}
			if elapsed := now.Sub(started); elapsed != test.wantElapsed {
				t.Fatalf("elapsed %s, expected %s", elapsed, test.wantElapsed)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestWindowsProcessWaiterClosesHandleBeforeDone(t *testing.T) {
	executable, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	process, err := (windowsPlatform{}).Start(executable, []string{"-test.run=^TestWindowsFixtureChild$", "--", "fixture-child-success"}, privateTestDirectory(t))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer process.Finish()
	stdout := make(chan error, 1)
	stderr := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { _, err := io.Copy(io.Discard, process.Output()); stdout <- err }()
	go func() { _, err := io.Copy(io.Discard, process.Errors()); stderr <- err }()
	select {
	case <-process.Done():
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("root did not exit")
	}
	owned := process.(*windowsChild)
	if !owned.exitObserved || owned.processCloseErr != nil || owned.Result() != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Done preceded successful wait/handle close: exited=%v close=%v result=%v", owned.exitObserved, owned.processCloseErr, owned.Result())
	}
	owned.processMu.Lock()
	retained := owned.process
	owned.processMu.Unlock()
	if retained != 0 {
		t.Fatal("Done preceded release of the retained process handle")
	}
	for _, stream := range []<-chan error{stdout, stderr} {
		select {
		case err := <-stream:
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		case <-time.After(time.Second):
			t.Fatal("root output did not drain")
		}
	}
	if forced, err := process.Finish(); forced || err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("normal root did not reach actual empty job: forced=%v error=%v", forced, err)
	}
}

func TestOwnedJobSlowQueryCannotPassItsDeadline(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Unix(1000, 0)
	forced := false
	result, err := finishJobRundown(true, now.Add(10*time.Second), jobRundownOps{
		now: func() time.Time { return now },
		active: func() (uint32, error) {
			if !forced {
				now = now.Add(6 * time.Second)
			}
			return 0, nil
		},
		terminate: func() error { forced = true; return nil },
		pause:     func(time.Time) error { t.Fatal("empty query must not poll"); return nil },
	})
	if !result || !forced || !errors.Is(err, errJobRundownDeadline) {
		t.Fatalf("late empty query passed: forced=%v err=%v", result, err)
	}
	if err := pauseJobRundown(time.Now().Add(-time.Second)); !errors.Is(err, errJobRundownDeadline) {
		t.Fatalf("expired poll deadline ignored: %v", err)
	}
}

type controlTCPTestRow struct {
	local, remote controlEndpoint
	state, pid    uint32
}

func controlTCPTestTable(rows ...controlTCPTestRow) []byte {
	table := make([]byte, 4+24*len(rows))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(table, uint32(len(rows)))
	for index, value := range rows {
		row := table[4+24*index : 4+24*(index+1)]
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(row, value.state)
		copy(row[4:8], value.local.IP[:])
		binary.BigEndian.PutUint16(row[8:10], value.local.Port)
		row[10], row[11] = 0xa5, 0x5a
		copy(row[12:16], value.remote.IP[:])
		binary.BigEndian.PutUint16(row[16:18], value.remote.Port)
		row[18], row[19] = 0xa5, 0x5a
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(row[20:24], value.pid)
	}
	return table
}

func TestControlTCPTableOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	local := controlEndpoint{IP: [4]byte{127, 0, 0, 1}, Port: 31002}
	remote := controlEndpoint{IP: [4]byte{127, 0, 0, 2}, Port: 49231}
	correct := controlTCPTestRow{local: remote, remote: local, state: 5, pid: 731}
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func([]byte) ([]byte, uint32)
		rows   []controlTCPTestRow
		ok     bool
	}{
		{name: "reversed-tuple-network-order-upper-port-bits-ignored", rows: []controlTCPTestRow{correct}, ok: true},
		{name: "trailing-capacity", rows: []controlTCPTestRow{correct}, ok: true, mutate: func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) { return append(b, make([]byte, 32)...), uint32(len(b) + 8) }},
		{name: "unrelated-row", rows: []controlTCPTestRow{{local: local, remote: remote, state: 5, pid: 99}, correct}, ok: true},
		{name: "forward-tuple", rows: []controlTCPTestRow{{local: local, remote: remote, state: 5, pid: 731}}},
		{name: "wrong-pid", rows: []controlTCPTestRow{{local: remote, remote: local, state: 5, pid: 732}}},
		{name: "not-established", rows: []controlTCPTestRow{{local: remote, remote: local, state: 8, pid: 731}}},
		{name: "absent"},
		{name: "ambiguous", rows: []controlTCPTestRow{correct, correct}},
		{name: "conflicting-owner", rows: []controlTCPTestRow{correct, {local: remote, remote: local, state: 5, pid: 732}}},
		{name: "truncated-header", mutate: func([]byte) ([]byte, uint32) { return []byte{0, 0, 0}, 3 }},
		{name: "truncated-row", rows: []controlTCPTestRow{correct}, mutate: func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) { return b[:len(b)-1], uint32(len(b) - 1) }},
		{name: "returned-beyond-allocation", rows: []controlTCPTestRow{correct}, mutate: func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) { return b, uint32(len(b) + 1) }},
		{name: "count-beyond-returned", rows: []controlTCPTestRow{correct}, mutate: func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) { return b, 4 }},
		{name: "overlarge-count", rows: []controlTCPTestRow{correct}, mutate: func(b []byte) ([]byte, uint32) {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(b, ^uint32(0))
			return b, uint32(len(b))
		}},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			table := controlTCPTestTable(test.rows...)
			size := uint32(len(table))
			if test.mutate != nil {
				table, size = test.mutate(table)
			}
			err := verifyControlTCPTable(table, size, local, remote, 731)
			if (err == nil) != test.ok {
				t.Fatalf("ownership result=%v, want success=%v", err, test.ok)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestControlEndpointValidation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name string
		addr net.Addr
		ok   bool
	}{
		{name: "ipv4-loopback", addr: &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.ParseIP("127.0.0.1"), Port: 1}, ok: true},
		{name: "ipv4-high-port", addr: &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IP{127, 0, 0, 2}, Port: 65535}, ok: true},
		{name: "missing", addr: nil},
		{name: "typed-nil", addr: (*net.TCPAddr)(nil)},
		{name: "unix", addr: &net.UnixAddr{Name: "control", Net: "unix"}},
		{name: "ipv6", addr: &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.ParseIP("::1"), Port: 1}},
		{name: "non-loopback", addr: &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.ParseIP("192.0.2.1"), Port: 1}},
		{name: "wildcard", addr: &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4zero, Port: 1}},
		{name: "zero-port", addr: &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1)}},
		{name: "negative-port", addr: &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1), Port: -1}},
		{name: "overflow-port", addr: &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1), Port: 65536}},
		{name: "zone", addr: &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1), Port: 1, Zone: "zone"}},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			_, err := controlEndpointFromAddr(test.addr)
			if (err == nil) != test.ok {
				t.Fatalf("endpoint result=%v, want success=%v", err, test.ok)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestControlTCPQueryBoundsAndStatus(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name   string
		status uint32
		size   uint32
		ok     bool
	}{
		{name: "success", size: 4, ok: true},
		{name: "insufficient-buffer", status: 122, size: controlTCPTableCapacity + 4},
		{name: "access-denied", status: 5, size: 4},
		{name: "short-result", size: 3},
		{name: "oversized-result", size: controlTCPTableCapacity + 1},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			calls := 0
			table, size, err := readControlTCPTable(func(table []byte, size *uint32) uint32 {
				calls++
				if len(table) != controlTCPTableCapacity || *size != controlTCPTableCapacity {
					t.Fatal("query did not use the fixed one-MiB buffer")
				}
				*size = test.size
				return test.status
			})
			if calls != 1 || (err == nil) != test.ok {
				t.Fatalf("calls=%d result=%v", calls, err)
			}
			if test.status != 0 && !errors.Is(err, syscall.Errno(test.status)) {
				t.Fatalf("lost API return status: %v", err)
			}
			if test.ok && (len(table) != controlTCPTableCapacity || size != test.size) {
				t.Fatal("query lost its returned bounds")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestLiveControlPeerProof(t *testing.T) {
	local := controlEndpoint{IP: [4]byte{127, 0, 0, 1}, Port: 30123}
	remote := controlEndpoint{IP: [4]byte{127, 0, 0, 1}, Port: 49123}
	failure := errors.New("native query failed")
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name      string
		firstDead bool
		lastDead  bool
		pid       uint32
		pidErr    error
		tableErr  error
		cancelAt  string
		wantErr   error
		wantCalls string
	}{
		{name: "live-owned", pid: 731, wantCalls: "live,pid,table,live"},
		{name: "signaled-before-query", firstDead: true, pid: 731, wantErr: failure, wantCalls: "live"},
		{name: "signaled-after-query", lastDead: true, pid: 731, wantErr: failure, wantCalls: "live,pid,table,live"},
		{name: "handle-pid-mismatch", pid: 732, wantCalls: "live,pid"},
		{name: "handle-pid-query-error", pidErr: failure, wantErr: failure, wantCalls: "live,pid"},
		{name: "table-query-error", pid: 731, tableErr: failure, wantErr: failure, wantCalls: "live,pid,table"},
		{name: "expired-before-proof", pid: 731, cancelAt: "before", wantErr: context.Canceled},
		{name: "expired-before-table", pid: 731, cancelAt: "pid", wantErr: context.Canceled, wantCalls: "live,pid"},
		{name: "expired-after-table", pid: 731, cancelAt: "table", wantErr: context.Canceled, wantCalls: "live,pid,table"},
		{name: "expired-after-final-live", pid: 731, cancelAt: "last-live", wantErr: context.Canceled, wantCalls: "live,pid,table,live"},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			defer cancel()
			if test.cancelAt == "before" {
				cancel()
			}
			var calls []string
			livenessChecks := 0
			err := verifyLiveControlPeer(ctx, 731, local, remote, controlPeerOps{
				live: func() error {
					calls = append(calls, "live")
					livenessChecks++
					if livenessChecks == 1 && test.firstDead || livenessChecks == 2 && test.lastDead {
						return failure
					}
					if livenessChecks == 2 && test.cancelAt == "last-live" {
						cancel()
					}
					return nil
				},
				pid: func() (uint32, error) {
					calls = append(calls, "pid")
					if test.cancelAt == "pid" {
						cancel()
					}
					return test.pid, test.pidErr
				},
				table: func() ([]byte, uint32, error) {
					calls = append(calls, "table")
					if test.cancelAt == "table" {
						cancel()
					}
					table := controlTCPTestTable(controlTCPTestRow{local: remote, remote: local, state: 5, pid: 731})
					return table, uint32(len(table)), test.tableErr
				},
			})
			if test.name == "live-owned" && err != nil || test.name != "live-owned" && err == nil {
				t.Fatalf("proof result=%v", err)
			}
			if test.wantErr != nil && !errors.Is(err, test.wantErr) {
				t.Fatalf("lost cause: %v", err)
			}
			if got := strings.Join(calls, ","); got != test.wantCalls {
				t.Fatalf("proof calls=%q, want=%q", got, test.wantCalls)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestOwnedJobAbsoluteCleanupDeadline(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name      string
		exited    bool
		remaining time.Duration
	}{
		{name: "expired-live", remaining: 0},
		{name: "expired-exited", exited: true, remaining: 0},
		{name: "natural-remainder", exited: true, remaining: time.Second},
		{name: "forced-remainder", remaining: time.Second},
		{name: "shared-seven-second-budget", exited: true, remaining: 7 * time.Second},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			start := time.Unix(1000, 0)
			now := start
			queries, terminations := 0, 0
			forced, err := finishJobRundown(test.exited, start.Add(test.remaining), jobRundownOps{
				now:       func() time.Time { return now },
				active:    func() (uint32, error) { queries++; return 1, nil },
				terminate: func() error { terminations++; return nil },
				pause: func(deadline time.Time) error {
					now = clampJobDeadline(now.Add(time.Second), deadline)
					return nil
				},
			})
			if !forced || terminations != 1 || !errors.Is(err, errJobRundownDeadline) || now.Sub(start) != test.remaining {
				t.Fatalf("forced=%v terminations=%d elapsed=%s err=%v", forced, terminations, now.Sub(start), err)
			}
			if test.remaining == 0 && queries != 0 {
				t.Fatal("expired cleanup performed another state query")
			}
		})
	}
}

func startWindowsSocketTestChild(t *testing.T, mode string, args ...string) *windowsChild {
	t.Helper()
	executable, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	command := append([]string{"-test.run=^TestWindowsFixtureChild$", "--"}, args...)
	command = append(command, mode)
	process, err := (windowsPlatform{}).Start(executable, command, privateTestDirectory(t))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	owned := process.(*windowsChild)
	streams := make(chan error, 2)
	go func() { _, err := io.Copy(io.Discard, owned.Output()); streams <- err }()
	go func() { _, err := io.Copy(io.Discard, owned.Errors()); streams <- err }()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if _, err := owned.Finish(); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("owned socket child cleanup: %v", err)
		}
		deadline := time.NewTimer(5 * time.Second)
		defer deadline.Stop()
		for range 2 {
			select {
			case err := <-streams:
				if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrClosed) {
					t.Errorf("owned socket child log: %v", err)
				}
			case <-deadline.C:
				t.Error("owned socket child log did not finish")
				return
			}
		}
	})
	return owned
}

func TestWindowsControlSocketOwnedAndForeignPeer(t *testing.T) {
	for _, foreign := range []bool{false, true} {
		name := "owned-child"
		if foreign {
			name = "foreign-parent"
		}
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			listener, err := (windowsPlatform{}).ListenControl(ctx)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer listener.Close()
			deadline, _ := ctx.Deadline()
			if err := listener.(*net.TCPListener).SetDeadline(deadline); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			var process *windowsChild
			if foreign {
				process = startWindowsSocketTestChild(t, "fixture-child-sleep")
				conn, err := (&net.Dialer{}).DialContext(ctx, "tcp4", listener.Addr().String())
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				defer conn.Close()
			} else {
				process = startWindowsSocketTestChild(t, "fixture-child-control", listener.Addr().String())
			}
			conn, err := listener.Accept()
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer conn.Close()
			facts, err := process.VerifyControlPeer(ctx, conn)
			if foreign {
				if err == nil || facts != nil {
					t.Fatal("foreign test-parent connection authenticated as the owned child")
				}
				return
			}
			if err != nil || facts["owner_pid"] != process.PID() || facts["local_address"] != conn.LocalAddr().String() || facts["remote_address"] != conn.RemoteAddr().String() {
				t.Fatalf("owned connection proof: facts=%v err=%v", facts, err)
			}
			if err := conn.Close(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			select {
			case <-process.Done():
			case <-ctx.Done():
				t.Fatal("owned control child did not exit after EOF")
			}
			if _, err := process.VerifyControlPeer(ctx, conn); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("exited process retained authority to authenticate a socket")
			}
			if forced, err := process.FinishBefore(deadline); forced || err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("owned control child did not finish gracefully: forced=%v err=%v", forced, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestWindowsControlListenerExclusiveBind(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	listener, err := (windowsPlatform{}).ListenControl(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer listener.Close()
	if address := listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr); !address.IP.Equal(net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1)) || address.Port == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("listener endpoint: %v", address)
	}
	configured := false
	reuse := net.ListenConfig{Control: func(network, address string, raw syscall.RawConn) error {
		var socketErr error
		err := raw.Control(func(socket uintptr) {
			socketErr = windows.SetsockoptInt(windows.Handle(socket), windows.SOL_SOCKET, windows.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
			configured = socketErr == nil
		})
		return errors.Join(err, socketErr)
	}}
	challenger, err := reuse.Listen(ctx, "tcp4", listener.Addr().String())
	if challenger != nil {
		challenger.Close()
	}
	if !configured || err == nil || challenger != nil {
		t.Fatalf("reuse-address challenger was not refused after configuration: configured=%v error=%v", configured, err)
	}
	canceled, stop := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	stop()
	if extra, err := (windowsPlatform{}).ListenControl(canceled); extra != nil || !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		if extra != nil {
			extra.Close()
		}
		t.Fatalf("canceled listener setup: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestWindowsWaiterSerializesControlHandleClosure(t *testing.T) {
	process := startWindowsSocketTestChild(t, "fixture-child-wait-input")
	process.processMu.Lock()
	locked := true
	defer func() {
		if locked {
			process.processMu.Unlock()
		}
	}()
	if _, err := process.Input().Write([]byte{1}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	wait, err := windows.WaitForSingleObject(process.process, 5000)
	if err != nil || wait != windows.WAIT_OBJECT_0 {
		t.Fatalf("child exit not observed: wait=%d error=%v", wait, err)
	}
	select {
	case <-process.Done():
		t.Fatal("waiter closed a handle while the control proof held its mutex")
	default:
	}
	if process.process == 0 {
		t.Fatal("retained process handle disappeared while locked")
	}
	process.processMu.Unlock()
	locked = false
	select {
	case <-process.Done():
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("waiter did not finish after the control proof released its mutex")
	}
	process.processMu.Lock()
	retained := process.process
	process.processMu.Unlock()
	if retained != 0 || process.Result() != nil {
		t.Fatalf("waiter handle closure: retained=%v result=%v", retained, process.Result())
	}
	if forced, err := process.Finish(); forced || err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("waited child cleanup: forced=%v err=%v", forced, err)
	}
}
